children: Hyperbot data shows that Huang Licheng has closed all of his 10x leveraged HYPE long positions and now holds only Ethereum and Bitcoin longs. According to Odaily, the positions are valued at $128 million, with unrealized gains of about $1.08 million and a 22.8% return on investment.
His 25x leveraged Ethereum long is valued at $99.1 million and holds 40,050 ETH. His 40x leveraged Bitcoin long is valued at $30.62 million and holds 389 BTC.

title: Huang Licheng Closes 10x HYPE Long, Keeps Ethereum and Bitcoin Positions
